statement: RiemannHypothesis → Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 1 N).sum (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)/n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 1 N).sum (fun n => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)*Real.log n/n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
